# WeakAuras/WeakAuras2 — .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml
```yml
name: "Bug Report"
description: Create a report to help us improve
labels: ['🐛 Bug']
type: Bug
body:
- type: checkboxes
  attributes:
    label: Is there an existing issue for this?
```

...

```yml
      Do you have an error log of what happened? If you don't see any errors, make sure that error reporting is enabled (`/console scriptErrors 1`) or install [BugSack](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/bugsack) & [BugGrabber](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/
bug-grabber), yes both are needed.
      Note that if the error looks like `[string "--[[ Error in ' my awesome aura' ]` then the bug is in the aura that got mentioned, not in WeakAuras itself.
    render: Text
  validations:
    required: false

- type: textarea
```
